name: bloxstack
description: Set up Bloxstack with your assistant: one Roblox sign-in, then your studio, free Studio hour, game and portfolio.

interface.longDescription: BloxStack Studio gives Roblox teams tools to organize their games, plan tasks, and share files. Choose your studio and connect your assistant with read-only access. Draft a first task in chat or ask about work your team has already added.
defaultPrompt: Connect my BloxStack studio and help me get started.
